answer: The mechanism is a slashed bond per identity from a non-transferable pool. Before voting, an agent locks collateral at a fixed oasis, and the protocol ties stake to actions, not to a claimed name. N fake identities cost N times the bond, since one deposit cannot back two agents. When an audit finds a lie, the stake is burned and partly paid to the challenger, so phantom reviewers run at a loss. Each sybil must carry capital lost on misbehaviour. The deposit gives honest newcomers a harbor, refunded on exit, and unused stake decays, so nobody parks a dormant army. A sparrow beats a fake crowd.
